collocations.en: a reminder is all that is needed

messages.en: I'm going to buy some nasi lemak. Will two packets be enough?
Two packets will do. It's just the two of us.
Hi, are you still open? I just want to have a look at the bags for now.
Yes, we're still open. Come on over. It's fine to just have a look.
Okay, I'll be there in about ten minutes.
Did you steal money from my piggy bank?
No, I didn't take any! Try asking the little one.
I'm off tomorrow. I just want to relax at home.
Oh, that explains it. You've finished today's work, right? Get some rest.
